dino.description: Grounding DINO + SAM, prompts: empty shelf space, gap on shelf, missing product on shelf

depth.description: depth > 10 cm behind the local shelf front

yolo.description: pretrained YOLOv8 shelf-gap model (akul-29/Retail-Shelf-Gap-Detection_Model, class 'void') on 9 face-on renders of the 3D model, conf >= 0.25

frames_yolo.description: YOLOv8s fine-tuned on the public Kaggle void dataset (benchmark only: non-commercial data), run on the original video keyframes (square tiles), confidence >= 0.25, boxes placed on the shelf front and merged across keyframes; kept when seen in >= 2 keyframes

frames_yolo_dl.description: downloaded YOLOv8 (akul-29/Retail-Shelf-Gap-Detection_Model), run on the original video keyframes (square tiles), confidence >= 0.25, boxes placed on the shelf front and merged across keyframes; kept when seen in >= 2 keyframes

frames_rfdetr.description: RF-DETR Small fine-tuned on the public Kaggle void dataset (benchmark only: non-commercial data), run on the original video keyframes (square tiles), confidence >= 0.25, boxes placed on the shelf front and merged across keyframes; kept when seen in >= 2 keyframes
